sentence: This project uses optical clocks to measure gravity and the shape of the Earth.
This project studies a function called the period map that is associated with families of solutions to polynomial equations.
This project builds hardware and software tools that help assistive robots and people communicate with each other.
This project uses physical models to study how cancer cells and normal cells move together and how their chromosomes differ.
This project uses natural language processing and interviews to find out which skills employers want in mechanical engineering.
This project tries to find out when a large volcanic event under the ocean happened and whether it triggered ocean oxygen depletion.
This project builds a bridge inspection technology that makes three-dimensional digital models to find changes in bridge condition.
This project builds a framework to compare and visualize models of mergers of black holes and neutron stars.
This project uses diffusion MRI to watch how the tissue in the cervix and vagina changes during pregnancy.
This project builds systems that recover water and nutrients from livestock waste for water reuse.
This project builds manufacturing systems that use multiple processes and learn from each operation.
This project evolves yeast populations under antifungal drugs to see how the genome, transcriptome and epigenome change.
This project tests whether rockweeds and mussels protect other coastal species from heat waves.
This project studies how mechanical forces like blood pressure make human vascular smooth muscle cells switch from one state to another.
This project tests whether botflies will spread to higher elevations as the climate warms and harm deer mouse populations there.
This project compares resurrection plants with closely related non-resurrection plants to find which traits let them recover from a dry state.
This project builds statistical methods to study networks where relationships can be positive or negative.
